AGO.note: The consultation was an in-person event in Luanda; no online channel is stated.

facts.fact: The government portal reports that the Institute of Administrative Modernisation held a public consultation on the Angola Digital Acceleration Project (PADA) on 9 February 2024, with public and private institutions, NGOs and digital transformation experts taking part.
facts.system: Projecto de Aceleração Digital de Angola (PADA)
